From one simple video, Postura unlocks insights that drive safety and efficiency across your entire factory network.

[Book a demo](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ1vaRyHk2DvHW84TDK4rpDfgwOFSYqkmYbXOn_17BZ2S8BvLTSLYXhy7wdXo_DlMxpu61AJvnxv)

### The next-gen tool for optimising industrial workstations

Monitor safety and efficiency using only your smartphone. No wearables, no extra hardware — Postura analyses motion and risk in seconds through advanced AI.

[Book a demo](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ1vaRyHk2DvHW84TDK4rpDfgwOFSYqkmYbXOn_17BZ2S8BvLTSLYXhy7wdXo_DlMxpu61AJvnxv)

#### INDUSTRY-VALIDATED PROTOCOLS, ALL IN ONE PLATFORM

Whether you're focused on regulatory audits or LEAN cycle optimisation, Postura brings together the protocols you need — Need a specific one? Let's have a chat.

[Request yours](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ1vaRyHk2DvHW84TDK4rpDfgwOFSYqkmYbXOn_17BZ2S8BvLTSLYXhy7wdXo_DlMxpu61AJvnxv)

### Turn videos into   actionable insight

![rec.png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/bb8d4d_8770c35f38d24ae7955070f516196b5f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_328,h_408,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/rec.png)

Record Videos On-Site

Capture videos of workers using just your phone's camera, then upload them to our cloud.

![medium.png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/bb8d4d_3b0dcedc203e46f8b770aa380260cc66~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_328,h_408,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/medium.png)

Get a risk score

Improve ergonomics

Receive targeted suggestions to reduce risk and enhance worker safety.
